text:
Situation: Cephalexin 500 mg capsules are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 88 capsules (5 days), Corvale General holds 399 capsules (26.5 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 27 capsules (6.2 days). All sites use NDC 80425012101 labeled by Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1249914 at FEI 3017450153 (Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, operations listed as REPACK) ended 2024-09-06 and was classified VAI. FDA's shortage list does not include cephalexin as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: No national shortage exists. Internal distribution imbalances create low days-on-hand at East and Lakeside. General has sufficient stock to support transfers while maintaining two weeks of supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 157 capsules of 500 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 31 capsules of 500 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Monitor FDA shortage list and supplier communications daily — needs buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, Amella Pharma, LLC, or Avkare at this time because cephalexin is not on the FDA shortage list and no supply disruption is confirmed.
